title: Go-to-market symphony: blog, email, social, webinar orchestration and timeline
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Coordinate a single, synchronized announcement across blog, user email, social channels, partner newsletters, and a technical webinar. Produce a timeline with clear handoffs, content owners, embargo windows, and rollback triggers. The goal is to maximize reach while protecting SLAs and avoiding mixed messaging for Dedicated and Private customers. This ticket codifies the operational playbook and central timeline for the release; execution will be managed via the sub-issues for content and enablement.
acceptance_criteria: Master timeline published with per-channel publish windows and assigned owners
Final blog post approved by Communications + Legal and staged in CMS with embargo set
Customer email templates approved and scheduled in Intercom/Sendgrid; segmentation QA completed
Social copy and creative assets ready in Sprout Social with scheduling windows and fallback posts
Webinar deck, demo plan, and registration page live; rehearsals scheduled with engineering moderators
Release notes published in product docs and linked from blog; changelog entry created
Post-mortem templates and metric dashboards (traffic, conversion, support volume) prepared
checklists: Week -3: Draft blog > PM review > Engineering technical accuracy pass
Week -2: Legal/Compliance review > Copy edits > Design hero asset
Week -2: Sales enablement one-pager & FAQs > CS training slot scheduled
Week -1: Localization kickoff (EN, FR, DE) > Translation deadlines set
Day -2: Final content freeze > CMS staging push > Webinar dry run
Day 0 AM: Publish blog (embargo lift 09:00 PT) > Send targeted customer email 09:15 PT > Social cascade at 09:30 PT
Day 0 PM: Live webinar at 14:00 PT > Recording posted and added to blog
Day +1: Monitor analytics and support queue; escalate incidents per runbook
Day +7: Post-mortem and lessons learned captured
